# FlatBuffers

<!-- Generated by bazel run //tools/docs/languages:languages_bin -- --write from flatbuffers/lang.json and flatbuffers/defs.bzl. Do not edit. -->

## Install

Add `rules_dx` to `MODULE.bazel`:

```python
bazel_dep(name = "rules_dx", version = "<version>")
```

Load the rules from `@rules_dx//flatbuffers:defs.bzl`:

```python
load("@rules_dx//flatbuffers:defs.bzl", "flatbuffers_library", "flatbuffers_cc_library", "flatbuffers_java_library")
```

## Rules

### `flatbuffers_library`

Owns FlatBuffers schemas for dx lint. Includes resolve only from deps or the including file's directory.

| Attribute | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `srcs` | `label_list` | no | FlatBuffers schema files of this package. |
| `deps` | `label_list` | no | flatbuffers_library targets whose schemas these include. |

### `flatbuffers_cc_library`

C++ headers and runtime for flatbuffers_library schemas. Each library's headers are generated once, by its own aspect action.

| Attribute | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `deps` | `label_list` | no | flatbuffers_library targets to generate C++ for. |
| `gen_object_api` | `bool` | no | Also generate the object API (--gen-object-api). |
| `_runtime` | `label` | no |  |

### `flatbuffers_java_library`

Java classes and runtime for flatbuffers_library schemas. Each library is generated and compiled once, by its own aspect.

| Attribute | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `deps` | `label_list` | no | flatbuffers_library targets to generate Java for. |
| `_runtime` | `label` | no |  |

### `flatbuffers_rust_library`

```python
flatbuffers_rust_library(name, library, crate_name = None, deps = None, root = None, codegen_path = None, **kwargs)
```

Rust crate for one root schema and its include closure.

flatc --rust --gen-all emits the whole closure into one file, so the crate
is per root, not per flatbuffers_library. The runtime comes from the pinned
flatbuffers archive.

Args:
  name: Name of the rust_library.
  library: flatbuffers_library that owns the root schema.
  crate_name: Crate name dependents import; defaults to name.
  deps: Extra Rust dependencies of the crate.
  root: Root schema label; optional when the library owns one schema.
  codegen_path: Logical directory of the generated files in the dx sync projection.
  **kwargs: Passed to the rust_library (visibility, tags, testonly). edition, rustc_flags
    and the like replace the defaults; srcs and deps are added to them.

### `flatbuffers_conform_test`

```python
flatbuffers_conform_test(name, library, baseline, root = None, baseline_root = None, **kwargs)
```

Fails the build when library breaks compatibility with baseline.

Runs flatc --conform. flatc stops at the first error and skips deleted
tables and enums and renamed tables. The binary schema it writes can serve
as the next snapshot.

Args:
  name: Name of the test.
  library: flatbuffers_library to check.
  baseline: flatbuffers_library holding the previous schema.
  root: Root schema of library; optional when it owns one schema.
  baseline_root: Root schema of baseline; optional when it owns one schema.
  **kwargs: Passed to the build_test (tags, visibility, size).
